faq.question: Is MBBS in Georgia valid for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS degrees from recognized Georgian universities are valid in India. Indian students must pass the FMGE/NExT exam to practice medicine in India.

faq.question: What is the total cost of MBBS in Georgia?
faq.answer: The total cost of MBBS in Georgia usually ranges between ₹30 lakh to ₹45 lakh, depending on the university and living expenses.

faq.question: Is NEET required for MBBS in Georgia?
faq.answer: Yes, NEET qualification is mandatory for Indian students who want to study MBBS abroad.

faq.question: What is the duration of MBBS in Georgia?
faq.answer: The MBBS course duration in Georgia is 6 years, including 5 years of academic study and 1 year of clinical internship.
